# appgatesdp_entitlements_optimization_stats (Data Source)

Supported SDP Admin API versions: v25.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `graph_data` (Attributes List) Daily optimized-percent samples for graph visualization, one entry per day for the last 30 days. `daysAgo` is the X axis (0 = today, 30 = 30 days ago); `percent` is the Y axis (the optimized percentage on that day). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--graph_data))
- `id` (String) Identifier of the data source.
- `insufficient_data` (Number) Number of Entitlements with insufficient usage data to evaluate.
- `not_in_use` (Number) Number of Entitlements that are disabled.
- `optimized` (Number) Number of Entitlements whose access aligns with observed usage.
- `optimized_percent` (Number) Percentage of Entitlements currently considered optimized.
- `overprovisioned` (Number) Number of Entitlements granting more access than is being used.
- `total` (Number) Total number of Entitlements considered by the optimizer.
- `unlinked` (Number) Number of Entitlements that could not be correlated with observed traffic.
- `unused` (Number) Number of Entitlements with no observed usage.

<a id="nestedatt--graph_data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `graph_data`

Read-Only:

- `days_ago` (Number) Number of days before today this sample represents.
- `percent` (Number) Percentage of Entitlements considered optimized on that day.
